instruction: Set the default heading font size to 16 points in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the default heading font size to 16 points in LibreOffice Writer. The evaluator reads the registrymodifications.xcu file to verify the HeadingHeight value under DefaultFont settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the HeadingHeight property from the LibreOffice Writer configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu)

Metric correctly compares the extracted heading font size against the expected value using string equality
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter - when expected.type='rule', the expected parameter IS the rules dictionary, and the code correctly accesses expected.get('heading_size')
Expected value '16' correctly matches the instruction requirement (16 points)
Configuration file path is correct and persistent - no postconfig needed
Complete coverage: the instruction requires setting heading font size to 16 points, and the evaluator verifies exactly this
Error handling is present in both getter and metric functions
